question: Shruti Sadolikar is an Indian classical singer of the Khayal genre of which Gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shruti Sadolikar is a renowned Indian classical vocalist known for her contributions to the **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana** of Hindustani classical music.
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana is famous for its intricate and complex **ragas**, particularly rare or compound ragas like Basanti Kedar and Sampoorna Malkauns.
 
• Shruti Sadolikar trained under her father, Wamanrao Sadolikar, who was a disciple of Ustad Alladiya Khan, the founder of the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana.
 
• She is celebrated for her deep understanding of rhythm (layakari) and her ability to present compositions with clarity and precision.
 
• In addition to her performances, she has played a pivotal role in preserving the traditions of the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana and spreading awareness about its unique style.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patiala Gharana**

 
 
• The Patiala Gharana is another prominent school of Hindustani classical music, known for its focus on **taans** (fast melodic passages) and **bol baant** (syllabic variations).
 
• This Gharana is associated with artists such as Bade Ghulam Ali Khan and his son Munawar Ali Khan.
 
• Unlike the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana, the Patiala Gharana emphasizes emotional expression and ornamentation, making its style more accessible to audiences.
 
 
 
• **Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana**
 
 
• Founded in Uttar Pradesh, this Gharana is an offshoot of the Gwalior Gharana and emphasizes clear enunciation of lyrics and the beauty of the raga.
 
• Artists such as Ustad Nissar Hussain Khan and Ustad Rashid Khan belong to this school.
 
• This Gharana is known for its systematic raga development and intricate aakar taans.
 
 
 
• **Mewati Gharana**
 
 
• The Mewati Gharana is associated with the legendary Pandit Jasraj and is known for its devotional and spiritual approach to music.
 
• This Gharana focuses on the emotional rendering of ragas and often incorporates elements of **bhajans** and **kirtans**.
 
• It combines traditional techniques with modern sensibilities, making it highly popular among global audiences.
